commit_message:
[Merged] [interpreter] Elide more TDZ hole checks

Add an analysis to the BytecodeGenerator that elides subsequent hole
checks after the first one in basic blocks.

Guarded by --ignition-elide-redundant-tdz-checks.

For more details, see
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1klT7-tQpxtYbwhssRDKfUMEgm-NS3iUeMuApuRgZnAw/edit?usp=sharing

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 22e9d9621de5 on top of intro da0bcffa3d0c via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: The TDZ hole check elision optimization (`ignition_elide_redundant_tdz_checks`) added in `da0bcffa3d` placed `HoleCheckElisionScope elider(this)` at the start of `BuildOptionalChain`, covering the invocation of `expression_func()`. This function callback visits the actual chain expression, which may include TDZ variable accesses. The elision scope incorrectly treats all hole checks within the chain expression as redundant and suppresses them. The underlying assumption — that links 'earlier in the chain dominate later links' — applies to consecutive links of the same optional chain, but it incorrectly extends to the base object access itself, which is NOT dominated by any prior hole check.
